items.source: Note that BeanDefinitionRegistryPostProcessor types may not be registered here, due to lifecycle constraints related to @Configuration class processing.
items.translation: 请注意，由于与 `@Configuration` 类处理相关的生活周期限制，可能无法在此处注册 `BeanDefinitionRegistryPostProcessor` 类型。

items.source: The bean name of the HttpServiceProxyRegistry.
items.translation: 该 `HttpServiceProxyRegistry` 的圈名。

items.source: metadata - annotation metadata of the importing class
items.translation: metadata - 导入类的注解元数据

items.source: Subclasses determine the HTTP Service types (interfaces with @HttpExchange methods) to register by implementing registerHttpServices(AbstractHttpServiceRegistrar.GroupRegistry, AnnotationMetadata).
items.translation: 子类通过实现 registerHttpServices(AbstractHttpServiceRegistrar.GroupRegistry, AnnotationMetadata) 来确定要注册的 HTTP Service 类型（带有 @HttpExchange 方法的接口）。

items.source: There is built-in support for declaring HTTP Services through ImportHttpServices annotations. It is also possible to perform registrations directly, sourced in another way, by extending this class.
items.translation: 内置支持通过 `ImportHttpServices` 注解声明 HTTP 服务。此外，还可以通过扩展此类以另一种方式直接执行注册。

items.source: An application can autowire HTTP Service proxy beans, or autowire the HttpServiceProxyRegistry from which to obtain proxies.
items.translation: 应用程序可以自动装配 HTTP 服务代理 Bean，或者自动装配用于获取代理的HttpServiceProxyRegistry。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to ImportBeanDefinitionRegistrar.registerBeanDefinitions(AnnotationMetadata, BeanDefinitionRegistry).
items.translation: 默认实现委托给ImportBeanDefinitionRegistrar.registerBeanDefinitions(AnnotationMetadata, BeanDefinitionRegistry)。

items.source: It is possible to import multiple instances of this registrar type. Subsequent imports update the existing registry FactoryBean definition, and likewise merge HTTP Service group definitions.
items.translation: 可以导入该注册表类型的多个实例。后续的导入将更新现有的注册表 `FactoryBean` 定义，并同样合并 HTTP Service 组定义。

items.source: By default, when this property is not set, then REST_CLIENT is used for any HTTP Service group whose client type remains unspecified.
items.translation: 默认情况下，当未设置此属性时，对于任何客户端类型仍为未指定的 HTTP 服务组，将使用REST_CLIENT。

items.source:
This method is called before any bean definition registrations are made.
Subclasses must implement it to register the HTTP Services for which bean
definitions for which proxies need to be created.
items.translation: 此方法在注册任何 Bean 定义之前被调用。子类必须实现它以注册需要创建代理的 HTTP 服务的 Bean 定义。

items.source: generator - the bean name generator strategy for imported beans: ConfigurationClassPostProcessor.IMPORT_BEAN_NAME_GENERATOR by default, or a user-provided one if ConfigurationClassPostProcessor.setBeanNameGenerator(BeanNameGenerator) has been set. In the latter case, the passed-in strategy will be the same used for component scanning in the containing application context (otherwise, the default component-scan naming strategy is AnnotationBeanNameGenerator.INSTANCE).
items.translation: generator - 用于导入 Bean 的 Bean 名称生成策略：默认为ConfigurationClassPostProcessor.IMPORT_BEAN_NAME_GENERATOR，或者如果已设置ConfigurationClassPostProcessor.setBeanNameGenerator(BeanNameGenerator)，则为用户提供的策略。在后一种情况下，传入的策略将与包含应用程序上下文中使用的组件扫描策略相同（否则，默认的组件扫描命名策略为AnnotationBeanNameGenerator.INSTANCE）。

items.source: Bean definition for an HttpServiceProxyRegistryFactoryBean that initializes the infrastructure for each group, RestClient or WebClient and a proxy factory, necessary to create the proxies.
items.translation: 用于 `HttpServiceProxyRegistryFactoryBean` 的 Bean 定义，该定义会初始化每个组、`RestClient` 或 `WebClient` 以及代理工厂所需的基础设施，以创建这些代理。
